_comment: Atlas Search (lexical) index for support_conversations. Apply via the seed script (createSearchIndexes), the Atlas UI (Search > Create Index > JSON Editor), or Atlas CLI: `atlas search indexes create --collection support_conversations --file support_text_idx.json --clusterName <cluster>`. Index name MUST be `support_text_idx` to match `IDX_SUPPORT_SEARCH` in app/db.py.
name: support_text_idx
